exposure: Daily consumption of Lentinus edodes (shiitake mushroom) administered before implantation (gestational days 1-19) and after implantation (gestational days 9-19)
outcome: Maternal biochemical parameters (albumin, calcium, creatine kinase, alkaline phosphatase, transferases, creatinine, urea, triglycerides, cholesterol, lipase, glucose, insulin)
Maternal hematological parameters (hemoglobin, hematocrit, white and red blood cells, platelets)
cohort: Pregnant rats were daily exposed to Lentinus edodes during specific periods of gestation.
finding: Consumption of L. edodes in pregnant rats reduced maternal triglyceride levels but showed no adverse effects on maternal weight, other biochemical/hematological parameters, organ weight, reproductive capacity, or fetal morphological development.
gest_age: Fetuses were analyzed at 20 days of gestation.
